Output terms were not read, so nothing is promised here. Check Paradox's and Steam's rules for AI-generated mod assets before publishing. models.notes: POST /v2/image/generate/ideogram-4-5, multipart. Edits send the base image first and any references after it as images (up to 5 in all, the first is edited), with size=source. A reference on a plain generation is refused, because the endpoint would treat the first one as the image to edit. Transparent background: background=transparent (documented as an alpha channel). Quality maps low to medium (very_low needs a source image), medium to medium and high to high. Pricing is tiered: up to 1024x1024 bills as 1K, larger as 2K, so the sizes offered stay at or under 1 megapixel. The size list is the Ideogram 4.0 resolution list, because the 4.5 page names no list (1024x1024, 2048x2048 and 1440x2880 are its examples). Masks are not sent: Ideogram's mask is black for the edit area, the opposite of this tool's alpha mask. negative_prompt is not documented for 4.5 and is not sent. magic_prompt is off. Not live-verified.
